title: Concept: Anchor opens a new tab without rel=noopener
description: A target="_blank" link without rel=noopener hands the opened page a live window.opener reference. That page can redirect the tab the user trusts, which turns any outbound link into a phishing pivot; the reverse-tabnabbing class survives in browsers and frameworks that do not imply noopener.
applicability: Responses that contain HTML anchors opened in a new browsing context.
risk: A linked third-party page can navigate the original tab to an attacker origin, so the user continues from a trusted URL into a controlled page.
